name: Ruby
note: Object-oriented scripting language with blocks, functional idioms, and extensive metaprogramming

typeSystemExample.caption: Generic max: duck-typed, any Comparable works
typeSystemExample.source:
def max_of(a, b)
  a >= b ? a : b
end

puts max_of(3, 7)
puts max_of(1.5, 2.8)

runtime: CRuby compiles source to YARV bytecode and executes it on a garbage-collected VM, with optional JIT compilation

runtimes.name: CRuby / YARV
runtimes.role: Reference implementation with a bytecode virtual machine.

runtimes.name: YJIT
runtimes.role: In-process JIT (written in Rust) that speeds up hot methods.

runtimes.name: JRuby
runtimes.role: Ruby on the JVM, benefiting from HotSpot's JIT.

runtimes.name: TruffleRuby
runtimes.role: GraalVM-based Ruby with an aggressive optimising JIT.

concurrencyModel: CRuby provides OS threads under a Global VM Lock, cooperative Fibers, and isolated Ractors that can run in parallel. Other implementations, including JRuby, can run Ruby threads in parallel without CRuby's GVL.

concurrencyExample.caption: 4 workers computing i*i in parallel via threads
concurrencyExample.source:
threads = (0..3).map do |i|
  Thread.new { i * i }
end

puts threads.map(&:value).join(' ')
